The supplied 'let it be' and 'that' ride with the prepositions of their verbless clauses' prepositional predicates under rule 62, headed on the prepositional word.

'at' stays with the adverbial superlative rather than riding with the article: the accusative has no case for an English preposition to realize under rules 21 and 106. ἀνὰ μέρος is spread over two English words, so rule 94 keeps it two units.
